## Phase
Phase number and name:

## Owner(s)

## Implementation checklist
- [ ] All planned implementation tasks are complete.
- [ ] Code is committed and reviewed.
- [ ] Documentation is updated.

## Verification
- [ ] Owner self-testing completed.
- [ ] Peer testing completed by another member.
- [ ] Normal scenarios pass.
- [ ] Invalid-input scenarios pass.
- [ ] Authorization/ownership scenarios pass where applicable.
- [ ] Edge cases pass.
- [ ] Regression tests pass.

## Defects
- [ ] No open critical defects.
- [ ] Major defects are fixed or explicitly accepted by the team with a reason.

## Evidence
Link PRs, test output, Postman collection runs, screenshots and relevant commits.

## Gate decision
- [ ] Approved — next dependent phase may begin.
- [ ] Rejected — work remains in this phase.
